# Aging at Home Advisor

> Aging at Home Advisor is an independent U.S. consumer-information and referral website operated by ROI PERFORMANCE LLC. It is not a contractor, government agency, insurer, or medical provider.

## Preferred canonical source

- https://agingathomeadvisor.com/

## Main content areas

- Accessible bathroom planning: https://agingathomeadvisor.com/bathroom-accessibility/
- Tub-to-shower conversion: https://agingathomeadvisor.com/tub-to-shower-conversion/
- Walk-in showers: https://agingathomeadvisor.com/walk-in-showers/
- Walk-in tubs: https://agingathomeadvisor.com/walk-in-tubs/

- Florida local guides: https://agingathomeadvisor.com/tub-to-shower-conversion/florida/

## Editorial conventions

- National planning ranges are not local quotes.
- Benefit eligibility and coverage are determined by the relevant program.
- Permit and license requirements should be confirmed with the issuing authority.
- City pages do not imply a local office, statewide partner coverage, or professional endorsement.
- Named government, Census, municipal, and primary sources are linked on relevant pages.
